label: preparing
what: A private celebration apparently marking my fortieth anniversary as mayor, in the great hall at eighteen today. The invitation is known to me but the surprise details were withheld. Innkeeper is arranging delivery and private payment; builder discussed an order with innkeeper; two hundred loaves and eight installed lanterns are planned, suggesting baker participation. Secretary coordinates confirmations and safeguards my schedule, and freight confirms the invitation remains on schedule. Baker participation is inferred rather than directly witnessed.
